Your Role

Here’s what you will be doing:

• Monitor portfolio risk metrics regularly and proactively flag anomalies or emerging trends.

• Perform root cause analysis when risk indicators deteriorate to identify drivers such as suspicious behavioral patterns.

• Translate findings into concrete recommendations and implement adjustments as needed.

• Build and maintain SQL-based features, analyses, and monitoring dashboards to support ongoing risk surveillance.

• Perform occasional model evaluation to support credit scoring improvements.

About You

The company is looking for candidates with the following skills and qualifications:

• Fresh Graduate or Bachelor's degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline (e.g., math, statistics, engineering, computer science); other disciplines will be considered.

• Experience using statistical computer languages such as Python, SQL, and MS Excel.

• Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team.

• Excellent problem-solving skills with a drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques.

• Willingness to learn new skills independently and strong sense of project ownership.

• Comfortable exploring data, investigating anomalies, and building SQL-based analyses.

• Experience working with large tabular datasets to detect trends and anomalies and communicate findings as actionable recommendations.

• Exposure to credit scoring modelling concepts is a plus.

cases.full_jd:
Kesempatan

Kami mencari Data Scientist yang berbakat dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA. Sebagai Data Scientist, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengubah data menjadi wawasan bisnis yang berharga untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan dan inovasi produk. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang analitik data, machine learning, dan pemodelan statistik. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu di Bandung, Jawa Barat, dengan kesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan berbagai departemen dalam organisasi kami.

Mengumpulkan, membersihkan, dan menganalisis dataset besar untuk mengidentifikasi pola, tren, dan anomali yang relevan dengan tujuan bisnis.

Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan model machine learning dan algoritma statistik untuk memecahkan masalah bisnis yang kompleks.

Membuat visualisasi data yang jelas dan presentasi insights yang dapat dipahami untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis oleh manajemen.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim teknis dan bisnis untuk memahami kebutuhan, mendefinisikan metrik kesuksesan, dan memberikan solusi berbasis data.

Melakukan riset dan eksperimen untuk mengevaluasi teknik data science terbaru dan menerapkannya dalam konteks bisnis.

Mendokumentasikan metodologi, proses, dan hasil analisis untuk memastikan transparansi dan reproducibility.

Memantau dan mengoptimalkan performa model yang telah di-deploy untuk memastikan akurasi dan efektivitasnya.

Persyaratan

Pendidikan minimal S1 Statistika, Matematika, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, Data Science

Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman profesional sebagai Data Scientist atau posisi sejenisnya.

Keahlian dalam bahasa pemrograman seperti Python, R, atau SQL untuk manipulasi dan analisis data.

Pemahaman kuat tentang konsep machine learning, termasuk supervised learning, unsupervised learning, dan deep learning.

Pengalaman dalam menggunakan tools dan library populer seperti Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, atau PyTorch.

Kemampuan untuk melakukan exploratory data analysis dan data visualization menggunakan tools seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau Matplotlib.

Pemahaman solid tentang statistik deskriptif dan inferensial serta metodologi penelitian.

Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk menjelaskan konsep teknis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

Pengalaman dengan database management dan big data technologies seperti Hadoop, Spark, atau cloud platforms akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Kemampuan problem-solving yang kuat dan attention to detail dalam bekerja dengan data.

Tentang Kami

PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA adalah lembaga keuangan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan perbankan berkualitas kepada komunitas lokal. Sebagai Bank Perekonomian Rakyat (BPR), kami fokus pada pemberian solusi finansial yang tepat untuk UMKM dan individu di wilayah Bandung dan sekitarnya. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri perbankan, kami terus berinovasi dan mengadopsi teknologi terbaru untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan kualitas layanan pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa data dan analitik adalah kunci untuk mengambil keputusan bisnis yang lebih baik dan menciptakan nilai tambah bagi pemangku kepentingan kami. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami dan jadilah bagian dari misi untuk memberdayakan ekonomi lokal melalui teknologi dan inovasi.

Pernyataan mana di bawah ini yang paling mendeskripsikan hakmu bekerja di Indonesia?

Perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Perbankan di Jawa Barat membuka kesempatan bagi Anda untuk bergabung dan berkarir bersama kami dengan produk andalan Kredit dengan jaminan BPKB Mobil, Motor, Sertifikat

As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

We are looking for an Intern to join the Templeton Global Investments team in Singapore office. The internship is expected to commence in December 2026 for 25 to 35 weeks.

We are seeking a technically strong and curious intern to work on applied machine learning research and AI application development. The intern will explore model optimization techniques, develop reusable machine-learning components, and build practical AI-powered tools for internal use. This role combines experimental data science with hands-on software engineering and is suited to someone who enjoys translating research ideas into reliable working systems.

How will you add value?

• Research automated feature engineering, feature selection, model optimization techniques and optimization approaches.
• Develop reproducible model-training and evaluation workflows, reusable machine-learning pipelines and components.
• Build proof-of-concept Artificial Intelligence tools, applications, backend services, Application Programming Interfaces and lightweight interfaces for internal workflows.
• Track experiments, results and computational performance, and evaluate solutions for accuracy, reliability and practical usefulness.
• Write tested, maintainable and well-documented Python code.
• Present findings, limitations and recommendations to stakeholders, and prepare technical documentation and knowledge-transfer sessions.

What will help you be successful in this role?

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong Python programming ability with a sound understanding of machine-learning fundamentals.
• Familiarity with feature engineering, model evaluation, hyperparameter optimization and libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn and XGBoost.
• Ability to design experiments carefully, interpret results critically and work with Git or an existing codebase.
• Strong problem-solving, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently while seeking guidance when appropriate.
• Knowledge of genetic algorithms, evolutionary computation and optimization methods.
• Experience with time-series modelling, validation and experiment-tracking frameworks.
• Familiarity with Structured Query Language and data pipelines.
• Exposure to Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interfaces, lightweight application development and production-oriented software engineering.
• Interest in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, cloud platforms, containers and continuous integration / continuous delivery.

Kesempatan

Kami mencari Data Scientist yang berbakat dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA. Sebagai Data Scientist, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengubah data menjadi wawasan bisnis yang berharga untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan dan inovasi produk. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang analitik data, machine learning, dan pemodelan statistik. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu di Bandung, Jawa Barat, dengan kesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan berbagai departemen dalam organisasi kami.

Mengumpulkan, membersihkan, dan menganalisis dataset besar untuk mengidentifikasi pola, tren, dan anomali yang relevan dengan tujuan bisnis.

Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan model machine learning dan algoritma statistik untuk memecahkan masalah bisnis yang kompleks.

Membuat visualisasi data yang jelas dan presentasi insights yang dapat dipahami untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis oleh manajemen.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim teknis dan bisnis untuk memahami kebutuhan, mendefinisikan metrik kesuksesan, dan memberikan solusi berbasis data.

Melakukan riset dan eksperimen untuk mengevaluasi teknik data science terbaru dan menerapkannya dalam konteks bisnis.

Mendokumentasikan metodologi, proses, dan hasil analisis untuk memastikan transparansi dan reproducibility.

Memantau dan mengoptimalkan performa model yang telah di-deploy untuk memastikan akurasi dan efektivitasnya.

Persyaratan

Pendidikan minimal S1 Statistika, Matematika, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, Data Science

Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman profesional sebagai Data Scientist atau posisi sejenisnya.

Keahlian dalam bahasa pemrograman seperti Python, R, atau SQL untuk manipulasi dan analisis data.

Pemahaman kuat tentang konsep machine learning, termasuk supervised learning, unsupervised learning, dan deep learning.

Pengalaman dalam menggunakan tools dan library populer seperti Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, atau PyTorch.

Kemampuan untuk melakukan exploratory data analysis dan data visualization menggunakan tools seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau Matplotlib.

Pemahaman solid tentang statistik deskriptif dan inferensial serta metodologi penelitian.

Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk menjelaskan konsep teknis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

Pengalaman dengan database management dan big data technologies seperti Hadoop, Spark, atau cloud platforms akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Kemampuan problem-solving yang kuat dan attention to detail dalam bekerja dengan data.

Tentang Kami

PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA adalah lembaga keuangan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan perbankan berkualitas kepada komunitas lokal. Sebagai Bank Perekonomian Rakyat (BPR), kami fokus pada pemberian solusi finansial yang tepat untuk UMKM dan individu di wilayah Bandung dan sekitarnya. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri perbankan, kami terus berinovasi dan mengadopsi teknologi terbaru untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan kualitas layanan pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa data dan analitik adalah kunci untuk mengambil keputusan bisnis yang lebih baik dan menciptakan nilai tambah bagi pemangku kepentingan kami. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami dan jadilah bagian dari misi untuk memberdayakan ekonomi lokal melalui teknologi dan inovasi.

Pernyataan mana di bawah ini yang paling mendeskripsikan hakmu bekerja di Indonesia?

Job Summary

Assist in analyzing sourcing, application, and placement funnels to support recruitment strategies. Develop predictive and classification models, design experiments and performance metrics, and create recruiter/client insights dashboards. Responsibilities

• Analyze sourcing, application, and placement funnels to identify recruitment trends and opportunities

• Develop predictive and classification models to enhance recruitment decision-making

• Design experiments and define performance metrics to evaluate recruitment processes

• Create dashboards that provide actionable insights for recruiters and clients

• Test and document data for bias and quality issues to ensure reliable analysis

• Collaborate with recruiters to translate analytical findings into operational improvements

• Learn recruitment workflows quickly and document work clearly under recruiter supervision

Preferred competencies and qualifications

• 1-3 years of relevant experience demonstrating practical application of skills at this seniority level

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, experimentation, data visualization, and data storytelling

• Diploma, degree, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technical, business, or creative discipline

At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

We are looking for an Intern to join the Templeton Global Investments team in Singapore office. The internship is expected to commence in December 2026 for 25 to 35 weeks.

We are seeking a technically strong and curious intern to work on applied machine learning research and AI application development. The intern will explore model optimization techniques, develop reusable machine-learning components, and build practical AI-powered tools for internal use. This role combines experimental data science with hands-on software engineering and is suited to someone who enjoys translating research ideas into reliable working systems.

How will you add value?

• Research automated feature engineering, feature selection, model optimization techniques and optimization approaches.
• Develop reproducible model-training and evaluation workflows, reusable machine-learning pipelines and components.
• Build proof-of-concept Artificial Intelligence tools, applications, backend services, Application Programming Interfaces and lightweight interfaces for internal workflows.
• Track experiments, results and computational performance, and evaluate solutions for accuracy, reliability and practical usefulness.
• Write tested, maintainable and well-documented Python code.
• Present findings, limitations and recommendations to stakeholders, and prepare technical documentation and knowledge-transfer sessions.

What will help you be successful in this role?

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong Python programming ability with a sound understanding of machine-learning fundamentals.
• Familiarity with feature engineering, model evaluation, hyperparameter optimization and libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn and XGBoost.
• Ability to design experiments carefully, interpret results critically and work with Git or an existing codebase.
• Strong problem-solving, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently while seeking guidance when appropriate.
• Knowledge of genetic algorithms, evolutionary computation and optimization methods.
• Experience with time-series modelling, validation and experiment-tracking frameworks.
• Familiarity with Structured Query Language and data pipelines.
• Exposure to Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interfaces, lightweight application development and production-oriented software engineering.
• Interest in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, cloud platforms, containers and continuous integration / continuous delivery.

cases.full_jd:
Your Role

Here’s what you will be doing:

• Monitor portfolio risk metrics regularly and proactively flag anomalies or emerging trends.

• Perform root cause analysis when risk indicators deteriorate to identify drivers such as suspicious behavioral patterns.

• Translate findings into concrete recommendations and implement adjustments as needed.

• Build and maintain SQL-based features, analyses, and monitoring dashboards to support ongoing risk surveillance.

• Perform occasional model evaluation to support credit scoring improvements.

About You

The company is looking for candidates with the following skills and qualifications:

• Fresh Graduate or Bachelor's degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline (e.g., math, statistics, engineering, computer science); other disciplines will be considered.

• Experience using statistical computer languages such as Python, SQL, and MS Excel.

• Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team.

• Excellent problem-solving skills with a drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques.

• Willingness to learn new skills independently and strong sense of project ownership.

• Comfortable exploring data, investigating anomalies, and building SQL-based analyses.

• Experience working with large tabular datasets to detect trends and anomalies and communicate findings as actionable recommendations.

• Exposure to credit scoring modelling concepts is a plus.

cases.full_jd:
Kesempatan

Kami mencari Data Scientist yang berbakat dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA. Sebagai Data Scientist, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengubah data menjadi wawasan bisnis yang berharga untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan dan inovasi produk. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang analitik data, machine learning, dan pemodelan statistik. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu di Bandung, Jawa Barat, dengan kesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan berbagai departemen dalam organisasi kami.

Mengumpulkan, membersihkan, dan menganalisis dataset besar untuk mengidentifikasi pola, tren, dan anomali yang relevan dengan tujuan bisnis.

Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan model machine learning dan algoritma statistik untuk memecahkan masalah bisnis yang kompleks.

Membuat visualisasi data yang jelas dan presentasi insights yang dapat dipahami untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis oleh manajemen.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim teknis dan bisnis untuk memahami kebutuhan, mendefinisikan metrik kesuksesan, dan memberikan solusi berbasis data.

Melakukan riset dan eksperimen untuk mengevaluasi teknik data science terbaru dan menerapkannya dalam konteks bisnis.

Mendokumentasikan metodologi, proses, dan hasil analisis untuk memastikan transparansi dan reproducibility.

Memantau dan mengoptimalkan performa model yang telah di-deploy untuk memastikan akurasi dan efektivitasnya.

Persyaratan

Pendidikan minimal S1 Statistika, Matematika, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, Data Science

Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman profesional sebagai Data Scientist atau posisi sejenisnya.

Keahlian dalam bahasa pemrograman seperti Python, R, atau SQL untuk manipulasi dan analisis data.

Pemahaman kuat tentang konsep machine learning, termasuk supervised learning, unsupervised learning, dan deep learning.

Pengalaman dalam menggunakan tools dan library populer seperti Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, atau PyTorch.

Kemampuan untuk melakukan exploratory data analysis dan data visualization menggunakan tools seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau Matplotlib.

Pemahaman solid tentang statistik deskriptif dan inferensial serta metodologi penelitian.

Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk menjelaskan konsep teknis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

Pengalaman dengan database management dan big data technologies seperti Hadoop, Spark, atau cloud platforms akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Kemampuan problem-solving yang kuat dan attention to detail dalam bekerja dengan data.

Tentang Kami

PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA adalah lembaga keuangan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan perbankan berkualitas kepada komunitas lokal. Sebagai Bank Perekonomian Rakyat (BPR), kami fokus pada pemberian solusi finansial yang tepat untuk UMKM dan individu di wilayah Bandung dan sekitarnya. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri perbankan, kami terus berinovasi dan mengadopsi teknologi terbaru untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan kualitas layanan pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa data dan analitik adalah kunci untuk mengambil keputusan bisnis yang lebih baik dan menciptakan nilai tambah bagi pemangku kepentingan kami. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami dan jadilah bagian dari misi untuk memberdayakan ekonomi lokal melalui teknologi dan inovasi.

Pernyataan mana di bawah ini yang paling mendeskripsikan hakmu bekerja di Indonesia?

Perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Perbankan di Jawa Barat membuka kesempatan bagi Anda untuk bergabung dan berkarir bersama kami dengan produk andalan Kredit dengan jaminan BPKB Mobil, Motor, Sertifikat

Assist in analyzing sourcing, application, and placement funnels to support recruitment strategies. Develop predictive and classification models, design experiments and performance metrics, and create recruiter/client insights dashboards. • Design experiments and define performance metrics to evaluate recruitment processes

• Create dashboards that provide actionable insights for recruiters and clients

• Test and document data for bias and quality issues to ensure reliable analysis

• Collaborate with recruiters to translate analytical findings into operational improvements

• Learn recruitment workflows quickly and document work clearly under recruiter supervision

Preferred competencies and qualifications

• 1-3 years of relevant experience demonstrating practical application of skills at this seniority level

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, experimentation, data visualization, and data storytelling

• Diploma, degree, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant technical, business, or creative discipline

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

We are looking for an Intern to join the Templeton Global Investments team in Singapore office. The internship is expected to commence in December 2026 for 25 to 35 weeks.

We are seeking a technically strong and curious intern to work on applied machine learning research and AI application development. The intern will explore model optimization techniques, develop reusable machine-learning components, and build practical AI-powered tools for internal use. This role combines experimental data science with hands-on software engineering and is suited to someone who enjoys translating research ideas into reliable working systems.

How will you add value?

• Research automated feature engineering, feature selection, model optimization techniques and optimization approaches.
• Develop reproducible model-training and evaluation workflows, reusable machine-learning pipelines and components.
• Build proof-of-concept Artificial Intelligence tools, applications, backend services, Application Programming Interfaces and lightweight interfaces for internal workflows.
• Track experiments, results and computational performance, and evaluate solutions for accuracy, reliability and practical usefulness.
• Write tested, maintainable and well-documented Python code.
• Present findings, limitations and recommendations to stakeholders, and prepare technical documentation and knowledge-transfer sessions.

What will help you be successful in this role?

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong Python programming ability with a sound understanding of machine-learning fundamentals.
• Familiarity with feature engineering, model evaluation, hyperparameter optimization and libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn and XGBoost.
• Ability to design experiments carefully, interpret results critically and work with Git or an existing codebase.
• Strong problem-solving, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently while seeking guidance when appropriate.
• Knowledge of genetic algorithms, evolutionary computation and optimization methods.
• Experience with time-series modelling, validation and experiment-tracking frameworks.
• Familiarity with Structured Query Language and data pipelines.
• Exposure to Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interfaces, lightweight application development and production-oriented software engineering.
• Interest in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, cloud platforms, containers and continuous integration / continuous delivery.

About The Company

Our client is a US-based software aggregator that leverages AI and machine learning to build scalable, intelligent solutions.

About The Role

Our client is seeking an AI / Machine Learning Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and deploying data-driven models into real-world applications. In this role, you will work on developing, training, and optimizing machine learning models, while collaborating closely with software engineers to integrate AI solutions into production systems.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning and AI models for real-world use cases.
• Work with structured and unstructured data to develop predictive, classification, or generative models.
• Develop and maintain data pipelines for data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
• Deploy machine learning models into production environments and monitor their performance.
• Optimize models for accuracy, scalability, and efficiency.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data) to translate business needs into AI solutions.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Warp, etc.) to improve development speed and code quality.

Qualifications

• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science roles.
• Excellent English communication skills.
• Strong proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or similar).
• Familiarity with deploying ML models in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional team.
• Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Warp) is a strong plus.
• Indonesian Citizen.

If you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment and are eager to work on impactful AI-driven products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

cases.full_jd:
Kesempatan

Kami mencari Data Scientist yang berbakat dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA. Sebagai Data Scientist, Anda akan memainkan peran strategis dalam mengubah data menjadi wawasan bisnis yang berharga untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan dan inovasi produk. Posisi ini memerlukan pemahaman mendalam tentang analitik data, machine learning, dan pemodelan statistik. Anda akan bekerja secara penuh waktu di Bandung, Jawa Barat, dengan kesempatan untuk berkolaborasi dengan berbagai departemen dalam organisasi kami.

Mengumpulkan, membersihkan, dan menganalisis dataset besar untuk mengidentifikasi pola, tren, dan anomali yang relevan dengan tujuan bisnis.

Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan model machine learning dan algoritma statistik untuk memecahkan masalah bisnis yang kompleks.

Membuat visualisasi data yang jelas dan presentasi insights yang dapat dipahami untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis oleh manajemen.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim teknis dan bisnis untuk memahami kebutuhan, mendefinisikan metrik kesuksesan, dan memberikan solusi berbasis data.

Melakukan riset dan eksperimen untuk mengevaluasi teknik data science terbaru dan menerapkannya dalam konteks bisnis.

Mendokumentasikan metodologi, proses, dan hasil analisis untuk memastikan transparansi dan reproducibility.

Memantau dan mengoptimalkan performa model yang telah di-deploy untuk memastikan akurasi dan efektivitasnya.

Persyaratan

Pendidikan minimal S1 Statistika, Matematika, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Informatika, Data Science

Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman profesional sebagai Data Scientist atau posisi sejenisnya.

Keahlian dalam bahasa pemrograman seperti Python, R, atau SQL untuk manipulasi dan analisis data.

Pemahaman kuat tentang konsep machine learning, termasuk supervised learning, unsupervised learning, dan deep learning.

Pengalaman dalam menggunakan tools dan library populer seperti Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, atau PyTorch.

Kemampuan untuk melakukan exploratory data analysis dan data visualization menggunakan tools seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau Matplotlib.

Pemahaman solid tentang statistik deskriptif dan inferensial serta metodologi penelitian.

Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik untuk menjelaskan konsep teknis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

Pengalaman dengan database management dan big data technologies seperti Hadoop, Spark, atau cloud platforms akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Kemampuan problem-solving yang kuat dan attention to detail dalam bekerja dengan data.

Tentang Kami

PT BPR KARYAJATNIKA SADAYA adalah lembaga keuangan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan perbankan berkualitas kepada komunitas lokal. Sebagai Bank Perekonomian Rakyat (BPR), kami fokus pada pemberian solusi finansial yang tepat untuk UMKM dan individu di wilayah Bandung dan sekitarnya. Dengan pengalaman bertahun-tahun di industri perbankan, kami terus berinovasi dan mengadopsi teknologi terbaru untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan kualitas layanan pelanggan. Kami percaya bahwa data dan analitik adalah kunci untuk mengambil keputusan bisnis yang lebih baik dan menciptakan nilai tambah bagi pemangku kepentingan kami. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami dan jadilah bagian dari misi untuk memberdayakan ekonomi lokal melalui teknologi dan inovasi.

Pernyataan mana di bawah ini yang paling mendeskripsikan hakmu bekerja di Indonesia?

Perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Perbankan di Jawa Barat membuka kesempatan bagi Anda untuk bergabung dan berkarir bersama kami dengan produk andalan Kredit dengan jaminan BPKB Mobil, Motor, Sertifikat

As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

We are looking for an Intern to join the Templeton Global Investments team in Singapore office. The internship is expected to commence in December 2026 for 25 to 35 weeks.

We are seeking a technically strong and curious intern to work on applied machine learning research and AI application development. The intern will explore model optimization techniques, develop reusable machine-learning components, and build practical AI-powered tools for internal use. This role combines experimental data science with hands-on software engineering and is suited to someone who enjoys translating research ideas into reliable working systems.

How will you add value?

• Research automated feature engineering, feature selection, model optimization techniques and optimization approaches.
• Develop reproducible model-training and evaluation workflows, reusable machine-learning pipelines and components.
• Build proof-of-concept Artificial Intelligence tools, applications, backend services, Application Programming Interfaces and lightweight interfaces for internal workflows.
• Track experiments, results and computational performance, and evaluate solutions for accuracy, reliability and practical usefulness.
• Write tested, maintainable and well-documented Python code.
• Present findings, limitations and recommendations to stakeholders, and prepare technical documentation and knowledge-transfer sessions.

What will help you be successful in this role?

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong Python programming ability with a sound understanding of machine-learning fundamentals.
• Familiarity with feature engineering, model evaluation, hyperparameter optimization and libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn and XGBoost.
• Ability to design experiments carefully, interpret results critically and work with Git or an existing codebase.
• Strong problem-solving, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently while seeking guidance when appropriate.
• Knowledge of genetic algorithms, evolutionary computation and optimization methods.
• Experience with time-series modelling, validation and experiment-tracking frameworks.
• Familiarity with Structured Query Language and data pipelines.
• Exposure to Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interfaces, lightweight application development and production-oriented software engineering.
• Interest in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, cloud platforms, containers and continuous integration / continuous delivery.

Our client is a US-based software aggregator that leverages AI and machine learning to build scalable, intelligent solutions.

About The Role

Our client is seeking an AI / Machine Learning Engineer who is passionate about designing, building, and deploying data-driven models into real-world applications. In this role, you will work on developing, training, and optimizing machine learning models, while collaborating closely with software engineers to integrate AI solutions into production systems.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning and AI models for real-world use cases.
• Work with structured and unstructured data to develop predictive, classification, or generative models.

• Deploy machine learning models into production environments and monitor their performance.
• Optimize models for accuracy, scalability, and efficiency.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data) to translate business needs into AI solutions.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Warp, etc.) to improve development speed and code quality.

• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Data Science roles.
• Excellent English communication skills.
• Strong proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or similar).
• Familiarity with deploying ML models in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional team.
• Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Warp) is a strong plus.
